name: What modifications make a kitchen senior-friendly?

mainEntity.name: What modifications make a kitchen senior-friendly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Senior-friendly kitchen modifications focus on safety, accessibility, and ease of use. This often includes features like lower countertop heights, pull-out shelving in cabinets, and wider pathways for mobility aids. Other considerations are lever-style faucet handles, improved lighting to reduce glare and enhance visibility, and non-slip flooring. Incorporating accessible appliance placement, such as wall ovens at an ergonomic height or dishwashers raised slightly off the floor, also significantly improves comfort and independence for seniors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Senior-friendly kitchens feature lower countertops, pull-out shelves, wider pathways, lever-style faucets, improved lighting, and non-slip flooring for safety and accessibility.
